easy: 20-20 window gaze
Look at something at least 20 feet away, out a window or across the room, and let your eyes soften on it for the full {seconds} seconds.
Palm blackout
Rub your palms together until warm, then cup them over your closed eyes and breathe slowly in the dark.
Clock eyes
Look away from the screen and slowly trace a big clock face with your eyes: 12, 3, 6, 9, then reverse.
Near-far focus
Hold a thumb 10 inches from your face, focus on it for 3 seconds, then on a far object for 3 seconds. Repeat.
Shoulder melt
Shrug your shoulders up to your ears, hold for 3 seconds, then drop them hard. Repeat 5 times.
Chin tuck reset
Sit tall and slide your chin straight back to make a double chin, hold 3 seconds, release. Do 6 reps.
Secret ankle circles
Lift one foot under the desk and draw 10 slow circles with your ankle each way, then switch feet.
Seated twist
Sit tall, put your right hand on the left chair edge and gently twist left for 10 seconds; repeat on the other side.
Box breath
Look away from the screen and breathe in for 4, hold for 4, out for 4, hold for 4. Two rounds.
Glute squeeze set
While seated, squeeze your glutes for 5 seconds, release for 2. Repeat 4 times.
Finger fan
Spread your fingers as wide as possible for 3 seconds, then make a soft fist. Do 8 reps, then shake out your hands.
Water mindful sip
Pick up your water bottle, turn away from the screen and take five slow sips while looking at the farthest point you can see.
Heel-toe rock
With feet flat under the desk, lift your toes up, then rock onto the balls of your feet and lift your heels. Repeat for {seconds} seconds.
Blink storm
Look away from the screen and blink rapidly for 10 seconds, then close your eyes gently for 10, then do 10 slow, full blinks.
Wrist wave
Extend one arm, gently pull your fingers back with the other hand for 10 seconds, then press them down for 5. Switch arms.
Neck side tilt
Drop your right ear toward your right shoulder for 10 seconds, then switch sides.
Neck half-circles
Slowly roll your head in half-circles from shoulder to shoulder, 5 times.
Shoulder rolls
Roll your shoulders backward 10 times, then forward 10 times.
Shoulder shrugs
Lift your shoulders to your ears, hold 3 seconds, drop them; repeat 5 times.
Wrist circles
Circle both wrists 10 times in each direction.
Wrist flexor stretch
Hold one arm out palm up and gently pull the fingers back for 10 seconds per hand.
Wrist extensor stretch
Hold one arm out palm down and gently press the back of the hand toward you for 10 seconds per hand.
Finger spreads
Spread your fingers as wide as you can, then make a soft fist; repeat 10 times.
Prayer wrist stretch
Press your palms together at your chest and slowly lower them until you feel a wrist stretch; hold 20 seconds.
Seated spinal twist
Hold the back of your chair and gently twist your torso for 10 seconds each side.
Overhead reach
Interlace your fingers, push your palms to the ceiling and hold for 15 seconds.
Side bend
Reach one arm overhead and lean to the opposite side for 10 seconds, then switch.
Chest opener
Clasp your hands behind your back, squeeze your shoulder blades and lift your chest for 15 seconds.
Chin tucks
Pull your chin straight back (making a double chin), hold 3 seconds, and repeat 6 times.
Seated hamstring stretch
Straighten one leg with the heel on the floor and hinge forward gently for 10 seconds per leg.
Ankle circles
Lift one foot and circle the ankle 10 times each way, then switch feet.
Seated figure-four
Rest one ankle on the opposite knee and lean forward slightly for 10 seconds per side.
Upper back round
Reach your arms forward, round your upper back and push your hands away for 15 seconds.
Cross-body shoulder stretch
Pull one arm across your chest with the other arm for 10 seconds, then switch.
Triceps stretch
Put one hand behind your head and gently press that elbow down for 10 seconds per arm.
Standing quad stretch
Hold the desk, pull one heel toward your glutes for 10 seconds, then switch.
Desk calf stretch
Hands on the desk, step one foot back and press the heel down for 10 seconds per leg.
Standing forward fold
Stand, hinge at the hips with soft knees and let your arms hang for 20 seconds.
Doorway chest stretch
Place your forearms on a door frame and lean gently through for 20 seconds.
Full-body wake-up stretch
Stand and stretch every limb long like you just woke up, holding for a few breaths.
Stand and reset
Stand up, take two slow breaths, shake out your arms and legs, and sit back down.
Calf raises
Holding the desk, rise onto your toes and lower slowly 15 times.
Walk to a window
Walk to the nearest window and back at an easy pace.
Refill your water
Walk to the kitchen or water cooler and refill your glass or bottle.
Sit-to-stand
Stand up and sit down slowly 8 times without using your hands.
Seated leg lifts
Straighten one leg, hold 5 seconds, lower it, and alternate legs.
Glute squeezes
Squeeze your glutes for 5 seconds and release; repeat 5 times.
Foot pumps
Point and flex both feet 15 times under the desk.
Shake out your hands
Let your hands go loose and shake them out for 15 seconds.
Short hallway loop

Pendulum arm swings
Stand and let your arms swing loosely side to side as you gently turn your torso.
20-20-20 eye break
Look at something at least 20 feet away for 20 seconds.
Palming
Rub your palms together until warm and cup them over your closed eyes for 20 seconds.
Slow full blinks
Blink slowly and completely 10 times to re-wet your eyes.
Eye figure-eights
Trace a large sideways figure 8 with your eyes slowly, both directions.

Close your eyes

Eye compass

Find something green

Box breathing
Breathe in 4, hold 4, out 4, hold 4, for two rounds.
4-7-8 breathing
Inhale for 4, hold for 7, exhale for 8, for one or two rounds.
Belly breathing
With a hand on your belly, take 5 slow breaths that push your hand out.

Set an intention

Count back by 7s

Times table

Name five

Wiggle your toes

Send a thank-you

Say hi to someone

Text a friend

Tidy one thing

Open a window

Water a plant

Listen to calm music

Look at a favorite photo

Get some daylight

Standing hip flexor stretch
Step one foot back into a small lunge by the desk and tuck your hips for 10 seconds per side.
Look over each shoulder
Slowly turn your head to look over your right shoulder, then your left, holding 5 seconds each; repeat twice.
Gentle smile
